sources.selection: One source representative each of oracle bone, bronze and Shuowen small seal when listed; absent stages are omitted.
sources.interpretation: Source-labelled specimens are not a universal chronological chain. Traditional source forms and modern simplified forms are distinguished. Dictionary sourceAnalysis is attributed wording, not an independent historical verification.
sources.storagePolicy: Page metadata is checked for every character. Local specimens carry byte hashes; remote specimens use only URLs actually discovered on the checked source page and have null hashes. Remote images are not claimed to be locally audited.
sources.displayPolicy: Display only storage=local image elements. Remote records are provenance links, not ready-to-display images (CDN blocks external hotlinks). Failed URLs are separate from absent historical records.

validation.scope: Exact source-page and same-stage gallery membership, captions, page hashes, raw/local asset hashes and SVG safety; not an independent historical interpretation review.

dataPolicy.association: Each record contains ancient specimens linked by the source dictionary entry. Linkage alone does not establish that the specimen is the modern target character itself, its direct ancestor, or a form belonging to the currently selected vocabulary sense.
dataPolicy.display: Describe these as related specimens linked by the source entry. Do not label an unreviewed specimen as the target character in a historical script, draw a direct source-specimen-to-modern-target evolution arrow, or use it as an identity quiz answer without separate character-specific evidence.
dataPolicy.sourceIndexLabels: A non-PUA unified Han codepoint in a Shuowen SVG filename may be shown as the source asset index character. This is an index label, not independent proof of etymological identity. Oracle-bone and bronze PUA filename numbers are resource identifiers, not characters to decode into a modern target.
dataPolicy.traditional: The traditional field preserves the first value of the source entry variant list. It is not a reviewed one-to-one traditional conversion for the selected HSK word or sense. Simplified character mergers and multiple senses can point to different traditional forms.
dataPolicy.counts: Coverage counts dictionary entries that link to ancient specimens, not a count of target characters with independently verified direct historical evolution.
